title: Video Games Dataset
description: A collection of computer video games including details about developers, publishers, pricing, and platform releases.

items.title: Video Game
items.description: An entity representing a video game along with its platform releases.

id.title: ID
id.description: Unique identifier for each video game entity (Primary Key).

title.title: Video Game Title
title.description: Official title of the video game.

launch_price_usd.title: Launch Price (USD)
launch_price_usd.description: Launch retail price in USD on the first platform where the game was released.

game_engine.title: Game Engine
game_engine.description: Engine used to develop the game.

multiplayer.title: Multiplayer Support
multiplayer.description: Whether the game has multiplayer (true or false).

platforms.title: Platform Releases
platforms.description: List of platform releases for this game, including release dates and review scores.

items.title: Platform Release
items.description: Details of the release on a specific platform.

name.title: Platform Name
name.description: Platform the game was released on (e.g., PC, PlayStation 5).

release_date.title: Release Date
release_date.description: Release date on that specific platform in ISO-8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD).

metacritic_score.title: Metacritic Score
metacritic_score.description: Metacritic review score (0-100) for that platform, or null if unrated.
